name: devplan
description: Product intelligence for software teams, powered by your Devplan workspace. Six dashboards refreshed every weekday: Daily Radar, Execution Monitoring, Demand Report with suggested projects and market trends, Stale Commitments, a searchable Changelog, and Engineering Analytics. Plan cycles from your team's real pace, and write specs that are tracked in Devplan automatically. Requires a Devplan account; setup walks you through creating one.

interface.longDescription:
Devplan is the product intelligence layer for software teams. It reads your code, tickets, Slack, docs, calls and support, and keeps a live map of your product: what exists, what's shipping, what customers ask for, and what was decided.

This plugin brings that map into ChatGPT and Codex. Setup builds six dashboards and refreshes them every weekday: Daily Radar (tailored to you), Execution Monitoring for planned and inferred projects, a Demand Report that turns customer demand and market moves into suggested projects, Stale Commitments, a searchable Changelog, and Engineering Analytics.

Plan a cycle from your team's real pace, choosing between a few strategic directions. Write specs with a short discovery conversation, a technical plan and an estimate, and every spec is tracked in Devplan automatically. Ask any product question and get answers that cite the PRs, tickets, calls and decisions behind them.

Requires a Devplan account. Setup walks you through creating one and connecting your sources.
defaultPrompt: What are customers asking for that we haven't planned?
